lines.en: label cafe45:
scene rindate1
I arrive at the cafe bright and early to find someone who is definitely not Rin hanging out behind the counter.
lines.zh: 我一大早就到了咖啡馆，却发现柜台后面站着的人绝对不是 Rin。

lines.en: I check my phone to make sure that I didn’t somehow oversleep and wander in at night instead, but I quickly realize that even {i}that{/i} wouldn’t explain the sunlight.
lines.zh: 我掏出手机确认自己没有睡过头、大半夜跑了过来，但很快就意识到，就算{i}那样{/i}也解释不了外面这阳光。

lines.en: So, why is Molly here?
lines.zh: 那么，Molly 为什么在这儿？

lines.en: And why are her eyes closed?
lines.zh: 还有，她为什么闭着眼睛？

lines.en: What is the meaning of this?
lines.zh: 这到底是什么情况？

lines.en: : Molly.
lines.zh: : Molly。

lines.en: : Shh...She’s sleeping.
lines.zh: : 嘘……她在睡觉。

lines.en: : Yes, Haruka. I have eyes. I can see that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Haruka。我有眼睛。我看得出来。

lines.en: : Well, it didn’t stop you from talking to her, soooo...
lines.zh: : 可这也没能拦住你跟她说话啊，所以嘛……

lines.en: : Because she’s supposed to be {i}working{/i}. As the owner, you should know this.
lines.zh: : 因为她{i}该在上班{/i}才对。作为老板，你应该知道这一点。

lines.en: : All I know is that I’d be asleep too if I had to go from night shift to morning shift so suddenly.
lines.zh: : 我只知道，要是我突然从夜班被调到早班，我也会睡着的。

lines.en: I start snapping my fingers, hoping that Molly will react in some sort of way.
lines.zh: 我开始打响指，希望 Molly 能有点什么反应。

lines.en: As you can see, she doesn’t.
lines.zh: 如你所见，她没有。

lines.en: So perhaps it’s time for me to try something different?
lines.zh: 那么，也许是时候换一招了？

lines.en: : Anime is stupid.
lines.zh: : 动画很蠢。

lines.en: scene rindate2
: Hah?! Wha?
lines.zh: : 哈？！什么？

lines.en: : Where am I? What’s going on?!
lines.zh: : 我在哪儿？发生什么了？！

lines.en: scene rindate3
: Wait...this world looks almost exactly like the cafe...
lines.zh: : 等等……这个世界看起来几乎和咖啡馆一模一样……

lines.en: : But it’s so bright...so it can’t be the {i}real{/i} cafe.
lines.zh: : 可是这么亮……所以不可能是{i}真的{/i}咖啡馆。

lines.en: : There’s even a Haruka clone sitting at the counter.
lines.zh: : 吧台那儿甚至还坐着一个 Haruka 克隆体。

lines.en: : Not a clone. Morning, Molly.
lines.zh: : 不是克隆体。早，Molly。

lines.en: : And she speaks our language as well...
lines.zh: : 而且她还说我们的语言……

lines.en: : This can't be...Earth...can it?
lines.zh: : 这里不可能……是地球……对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene rindate4
: Ah! Now there's a Sensei clone!
lines.zh: : 啊！现在又冒出来一个 Sensei 克隆体！

lines.en: : Three more and I can finally make my greatest fantasy come true!
lines.zh: : 再来三个，我就能实现我最伟大的幻想了！

lines.en: : ...Excuse me?
lines.zh: : ……抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it!
lines.zh: : 别在意！

lines.en: : No, now I’m genuinely curious.
lines.zh: : 不，我现在是真好奇了。

lines.en: : Same. Do tell, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我也是。说说看嘛，Molly。

lines.en: scene rindate5
: So, ummm...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……

lines.en: : I take it I was just sleeping on the job and I...haven’t been teleported into a nearly identical isekai?
lines.zh: : 所以我是上班睡着了，并没有……被传送到一个几乎一模一样的异世界里，对吧？

lines.en: : Correct. But why are you working so early? You’re a night person.
lines.zh: : 没错。不过你怎么这么早就来上班？你可是夜猫子。

lines.en: scene rindate6
: Ask Nithhala. She’s the one who went and scheduled her stupid date for today.
lines.zh: : 去问 Nithhala 啊。是她把自己那个蠢约会定在今天的。

lines.en: : Now I’ve gotta be the one to help all the morning people.
lines.zh: : 结果现在得由我来伺候这帮早起的人。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how low my mana is right now?
lines.zh: : 你知道我现在魔力有多低吗？

lines.en: : Not a clue.
lines.zh: : 一点都不知道。

lines.en: Huh. I knew Rin had a “date” with Otoha coming up, but I didn’t realize it was today.
lines.zh: 哦。我知道 Rin 要和 Otoha「约会」，但没想到就是今天。

lines.en: I wonder if she’s still planning on taking her to that arcade thing?
lines.zh: 不知道她还打不打算带她去那个游戏厅？

lines.en: : I’m sorry you have to cover her shift, Molly. But just think of all the extra money you’ll have to spend on...
lines.zh: : 我很遗憾你得替她顶班，Molly。不过想想那些多出来的钱，你可以拿去……

lines.en: : Spend on what? I want to hear your guess.
lines.zh: : 拿去干什么？我想听听你的猜测。

lines.en: : Dragon...stuff?
lines.zh: : 龙……相关的东西？

lines.en: scene rindate7
: Hohohoho...an excellent guess, Sir. But you’ll have to be a bit more specific about what type of dragon if you’re really going to excite me.
lines.zh: : 嚯嚯嚯……猜得不错啊，先生。不过要是真想让我兴奋起来，你得说得更具体一点，是哪种龙。

lines.en: : Your eyes are on fire, though.
lines.zh: : 可你的眼睛已经在冒火了。

lines.en: : And so is my heart...
lines.zh: : 我的心也在燃烧……

lines.en: : Umm, sorry to bother you two while you’re...bonding or whatever, but look who just came in.
lines.zh: : 呃，抱歉打扰你们俩……增进感情什么的，不过看看谁来了。

lines.en: : Hm?
scene rindate8
I turn around to find Rin standing there, decked out in her winter garb and looking up at me with a smile on her face.
lines.zh: 我转过身，看到 Rin 站在那儿，一身冬装，抬头朝我笑着。

lines.en: : Oh, hey.
lines.zh: : 哦，嗨。

lines.en: : Aren’t you supposed to be meeting Otoha this morning?
lines.zh: : 你不是该今天上午去见 Otoha 吗？

lines.en: : Molly just told me that was supposed to be today.
lines.zh: : Molly 刚跟我说约的是今天。

lines.en: : I got ditched.
lines.zh: : 我被放鸽子了。

lines.en: : Rin...
lines.zh: : Rin……

lines.en: scene rindate9
: Yeah, yeah. I know how it sounds. That’s really not what happened, though.
lines.zh: : 行行行。我知道这听起来像什么。不过事情真不是那样。

lines.en: : Otoha’s parents are just really strict and they don’t want her going out today since she’s been struggling with her homeschool stuff.
lines.zh: : Otoha 的父母就是特别严格，她在家自学的东西一直跟不上，所以他们今天不想让她出门。

lines.en: : I depleted my mana for nothing?!
lines.zh: : 我白耗魔力了？！

lines.en: : Rin, open me a portal to Dalaran! Drop a mage table! Do something!
lines.zh: : Rin，给我开个去达拉然的传送门！摆张法师餐桌！做点什么啊！

lines.en: scene rindate10
: Do you hear something, Sensei? I thought I heard Molly but I’m pretty sure she only works nights.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你听到什么声音了吗？我好像听见 Molly 的声音了，可我记得她只上夜班啊。

lines.en: : I haven’t heard anything all morning.
lines.zh: : 我一早上什么都没听见。

lines.en: : I’ll...I’ll use thaumaturgy to make my voice three times louder!
lines.zh: : 我……我要用奇术把声音放大三倍！

lines.en: : RIN! PORTAL!
lines.zh: : RIN！传送门！

lines.en: : There it is again. So weird.
lines.zh: : 又来了。真奇怪。

lines.en: scene rindate11
: Umm...a-anyway!
lines.zh: : 嗯……总、总之！

lines.en: : Are you...busy today?
lines.zh: : 你今天……有空吗？

lines.en: : I already took the day off and Futaba is at the library so I’ve kinda got...nothing going on for the next 24 hours.
lines.zh: : 我已经请假了，Futaba 又在图书馆，所以接下来 24 小时我基本上……没事可做。

lines.en: : And you’re absolutely sure Otoha isn’t able to go? I know how much you were looking forward to it.
lines.zh: : 你确定 Otoha 真去不了？我知道你有多盼着这天。

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe some other time. Definitely not happening today, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯……改天再说吧。反正今天肯定是没戏了。

lines.en: : She had her phone taken away. Pretty sure her mom texted me back or something since her texts started getting abbreviated all weird out of nowhere.
lines.zh: : 她手机被收走了。我猜大概是她妈妈替她回的短信什么的，因为她的短信突然就变得又简短又奇怪。

lines.en: : Then sure. I don’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 那当然可以。我一点都不介意。

lines.en: : It was a little shocking seeing Molly so early anyway. I don't have the energy to deal with her yet.
lines.zh: : 反正这么早看见 Molly 本来就挺让人震惊的。我现在还没精力应付她。

lines.en: scene rindate12
: Molly?...
lines.zh: : Molly？……

lines.en: : Sensei...Molly died five years ago...
lines.zh: : Sensei……Molly 五年前就死了……

lines.en: : Wha-?!
: I’m...a poltergeist?!
lines.zh: : 我是……骚灵？！

lines.en: : This explains so many things!
lines.zh: : 这解释得通了！

lines.en: : I still think about her every day...
lines.zh: : 我到现在每天都还会想起她……

lines.en: scene rindate13
: As do I...One never forgets their first kiss, after all.
lines.zh: : 我也是……毕竟谁也忘不了自己的初吻。

lines.en: : Uhh, excuse me? You two kissed and I didn’t hear about it?
lines.zh: : 呃，打扰一下？你俩亲过嘴，而我居然没听说过？

lines.en: : Quiet, Haruka. This conversation is not meant for adults.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Haruka。这话题不是给大人听的。

lines.en: : But...Sensei is...
lines.zh: : 可是……Sensei 是……

lines.en: : Shhhh...everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 嘘……一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : ...What?
scene rindate14
: So! Ready to come to a bunch of places you probably won’t enjoy and prevent me from getting all sad and feeling sorry for myself?
lines.zh: : 那么！准备好跟我去一堆你大概不会喜欢的地方，顺便阻止我自怨自艾了吗？

lines.en: : There’s nowhere else I’d rather be.
lines.zh: : 没有别的地方我更想去了。

lines.en: : That’s a lie, but thank you for saying it.
lines.zh: : 这是假话，不过谢谢你这么说。

lines.en: : I’d hold your hand but I don’t want you to get arrested and make today even worse.
lines.zh: : 我想牵你的手，但又不想害你被抓，把今天弄得更糟。

lines.en: : That works for me.
lines.zh: : 正合我意。

lines.en: scene black
: Uhh...have fun?
lines.zh: : 呃……玩得开心？

lines.en: : Haruka...can...
lines.zh: : Haruka……你能……

lines.en: : Can you see me?...
lines.zh: : 你能看见我吗？……

lines.en: : Weird...I could have sworn I heard something just now...
lines.zh: : 奇怪……我明明刚才好像听见了什么……

lines.en: : HARUKA!!!!!!
lines.zh: : HARUKA！！！！！！

lines.en: scene rindate15
Rin and I get off the bus probably twenty or thirty minutes later and step into yet another area of the city that I’m completely unfamiliar with.
lines.zh: 大概二三十分钟后，我和 Rin 下了巴士，踏进了城里又一片我完全陌生的区域。

lines.en: She checks a navigation app on her phone for a few seconds before grabbing my wrist and pulling me along.
lines.zh: 她盯着手机上的导航 app 看了几秒，然后一把抓住我的手腕拉着我往前走。

lines.en: We walk several blocks and it quickly becomes apparent that I may have needed an even {i}thicker{/i} T-shirt to survive this weather.
lines.zh: 我们走了好几个街区，很快就发现，今天这种天气，我大概需要一件{i}更厚{/i}的 T 恤才撑得住。

lines.en: The buildings are lined up in a way that turns the streets into a wind tunnel.
lines.zh: 两边的楼排成一列，把街道变成了一条风洞。

lines.en: And considering how cold it is today, there are barely any people ahead of us to serve as additional breaks for said wind.
lines.zh: 而考虑到今天有多冷，前面几乎没有什么人能替我们再挡一挡这风。

lines.en: We take everything in full force.
lines.zh: 我们硬生生承受了全部。

lines.en: But luckily for Rin, she’s so wrapped up in her thoughts that she remains completely unfazed.
lines.zh: 不过 Rin 运气不错，她整个人都陷在自己的思绪里，完全不为所动。

lines.en: : Like, for real, though. Why’d her parents have to pick {i}today{/i} to get all stupid?
lines.zh: : 说真的。她爸妈干嘛非得挑{i}今天{/i}集体犯蠢啊？

lines.en: : Any other day would have been cool, but nooooo. Let’s wait for a cute bisexual girl to come along and want to hold hands with our daughter before RUINING EVERYTHING.
lines.zh: : 换任何一天都行，可偏不。非要先等一个可爱的双性恋女孩出现、想牵我们女儿的手，然后再来毁掉一切。

lines.en: : I should kill them.
lines.zh: : 我该杀了他们。

lines.en: : Sensei, let’s go kill people.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我们去杀人吧。

lines.en: : Rin, I know you want to impress Otoha, but I can’t help but feel like there are better ways of doing that than killing her parents.
lines.zh: : Rin，我知道你想给 Otoha 留下深刻印象，但我总觉得，要达成这个目的，有比杀她父母更好的办法。

lines.en: scene rindate16
: Okay, fine. You wait outside and I’ll take care of the tough part.
lines.zh: : 好吧，行。你守在外面，难的部分交给我。

lines.en: : If Otoha tries to run away, though, you’ve gotta grab her so I can have a chance to explain myself.
lines.zh: : 不过要是 Otoha 想跑，你得抓住她，好让我有机会解释。

lines.en: : You’re not actually insane, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是真的疯了吧？

lines.en: : Is it insane to kill the people between you and your goal?
lines.zh: : 杀掉挡在你和目标之间的人，算疯吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Oh.
scene rindate17
: Well, maybe I am then.
lines.zh: : 那好吧，也许我确实疯了。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m just so friggin’ pissed off, you know?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我只是他妈的气死了，你懂吗？

lines.en: : I could barely even sleep because of how excited I was for this and now I’ve gotta hang out with {i}you{/i} instead.
lines.zh: : 我兴奋得一晚上几乎没睡着，结果现在得改成跟{i}你{/i}混在一起。

lines.en: scene rindate18
: Dude, I’m kidding!
lines.zh: : 老兄，我开玩笑的！

lines.en: : That was obviously a joke. You know you’re my favorite.
lines.zh: : 那显然是玩笑话。你知道你是我最喜欢的。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
: Like, what other person do you think could hook up with the one girl I wanted more than anyone else in the world and {i}still{/i} be able to spend time with me?
lines.zh: : 你想想，这世上还有谁能跟我最想要的那个女孩搞上，还{i}依然{/i}能跟我待在一起？

lines.en: : We’re stuck together, whether we like it or not.
lines.zh: : 我们被绑在一起了，不管愿不愿意。

lines.en: : Just like how I’m stuck with the memories of you burying your fingers inside of Chika while I was burying mine inside of myself.
lines.zh: : 就像我脑子里怎么也抹不掉那画面——你把手指埋进 Chika 里面，而我把手指埋进我自己里面。

lines.en: scene rindate19
: Whoops! Said too much.
lines.zh: : 哎呀！说漏嘴了。

lines.en: : Don’t want you taking advantage of {i}me{/i} next!
lines.zh: : 我可不想下一个被占便宜的是{i}我{/i}！

lines.en: : You’re really going to remind me of that every time we hang out, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是打算每次我们出来玩都要跟我提一遍这事，是吧？

lines.en: : Or until one of us dies. Either one works.
lines.zh: : 要么到死为止。哪个先来都行。

lines.en: else:
: Like, as far as people with penises go, you’re the number one prospect in my book.
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢，在有阴茎的人里，你在我心里排第一。

lines.en: : I know that compliment isn’t really anything I should write home about, but that does make me feel good.
lines.zh: : 我知道这种夸奖实在不值得我写信回家报喜，但这确实让我挺受用的。

lines.en: : Where do I stack up against the people without penises?
lines.zh: : 那在没有阴茎的人里，我排第几？

lines.en: scene rindate19
: Hmm...
: Close to the top still, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我想还是挺靠前的吧。

lines.en: : Like obviously below Chika and Otoha...But like, somewhere above Molly and Ami.
lines.zh: : 显然在 Chika 和 Otoha 下面……但大概在 Molly 和 Ami 上面。

lines.en: : Why is Ami on the list?
lines.zh: : Ami 为什么会在这名单上？

lines.en: : Ami’s cute and has good taste in manga.
lines.zh: : Ami 很可爱，而且看漫画的品味很好。

lines.en: : Plus she’s girly and I like girly girls.
lines.zh: : 再说她很有女孩子气，而我喜欢有女孩子气的女孩。

lines.en: scene rindate20
: I’d totally bang your [niece], dude.
lines.zh: : 我绝对愿意上你的 [niece]，老兄。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if I’m confused or aroused right now.
lines.zh: : 我现在分不清自己是困惑还是兴奋。

lines.en: : Why not both?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能两者都是？

lines.en: scene black
We walk several more blocks before finally arriving at the arcade Rin planned on taking Otoha to.
lines.zh: 我们又走了好几个街区，终于到了 Rin 本来打算带 Otoha 来的那家游戏厅。

lines.en: Just like she said, the place has a distinct “cool” aura to it. So much so that I feel a little out of place even coming here.
lines.zh: 正如她所说，这地方有股很鲜明的「酷」气场，酷到我光是走进来都觉得有点格格不入。

lines.en: But, I guess this arcade wasn’t exactly picked out with me in mind.
lines.zh: 不过，我想这家游戏厅本来也不是为我挑的。

lines.en: This was supposed to be a date for her and another, equally cute girl.
lines.zh: 这本该是她和另一个同样可爱的女孩的约会。

lines.en: I’m just a backup right now.
lines.zh: 我现在只是个备胎。

lines.en: So I guess it falls on me to...soak up Rin’s handpicked, special date stuff and make her happy.
lines.zh: 所以我想，接下来该由我来……吸收掉 Rin 精心挑选的约会内容，让她开心起来。

lines.en: scene rindate21
: Here we are! Couch Potato!
lines.zh: : 我们到啦！沙发土豆！

lines.en: : What did you just call me?
lines.zh: : 你刚叫我什么？

lines.en: : Huh? Couch Potato is the name of the arcade.
lines.zh: : 啊？沙发土豆是这家游戏厅的名字。

lines.en: : To my right, you will see a wonderful selection of alcoholic beverages that I am not yet legally allowed to consume.
lines.zh: : 在我的右手边，你会看到一系列很棒的酒精饮料，而我还没到可以合法饮用的年纪。

lines.en: : If you want to get hammered, though, go right ahead! I understand the risks that come with dating an adult!
lines.zh: : 不过你要是想喝个烂醉，尽管上！我理解跟成年人约会要承担的风险！

lines.en: : I think I can go the afternoon without drinking, but thank you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我可以撑一个下午不喝酒，不过还是谢谢你。

lines.en: : You sure? I’m kind of interested in what drunken Sensei would be like.
lines.zh: : 你确定？我还挺想知道喝醉的 Sensei 会是什么样。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine it would be anything you enjoy.
lines.zh: : 我想象不出那会是你喜欢的样子。

lines.en: : Probably not but REGARDLESS-
lines.zh: : 大概不会，不过无所谓——

lines.en: scene rindate22
: We are here to have a good time and forget all about our debatably bisexual musician friends.
lines.zh: : 我们是来开心的，是要把那些「存疑的双性恋音乐家」朋友全忘掉的。

lines.en: : I only have one musician friend and she is already a confirmed bisexual.
lines.zh: : 我只有一个音乐家朋友，而且她已经确认是双性恋了。

lines.en: : Maya is also a musician, Sensei. And she’s still up in the air.
lines.zh: : Maya 也是音乐家啊，Sensei。她还说不准呢。

lines.en: : So while I’m thinking about {i}my{/i} debatably bisexual musician friend, you can just think about Maya.
lines.zh: : 所以我想着{i}我的{/i}那位存疑的双性恋音乐家朋友时，你就想着 Maya 吧。

lines.en: : Thinking about Maya is exhausting. I’ll just think about Otoha as well.
lines.zh: : 想 Maya 太累了。我还是也想着 Otoha 吧。

lines.en: : Fine. But please keep her clothes on in your imagination.
lines.zh: : 行。但你在想象里请让她穿着衣服。

lines.en: : Will you be abiding by that same rule?
lines.zh: : 你也会遵守同样的规则吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不会。

lines.en: scene rindate23
: But anyway, all the games and stuff should be somewhere behind me in the back corner.
lines.zh: : 总之，所有的游戏机什么的应该都在我身后那个后角落里。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what you’re into, so just come with me and play some of the stuff I do.
lines.zh: : 我不太清楚你喜欢什么，所以就跟着我，玩点我玩的东西吧。

lines.en: : Oh, and don’t cry too hard when I {i}friggin’ annihilate you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，等我{i}他妈把你打得落花流水{/i}的时候，别哭得太厉害。

lines.en: : You’re very good at being intimidating and adorable at the same time, Rin.
lines.zh: : 你真的很擅长同时做到又吓人又可爱，Rin。

lines.en: : And you’re very good at...stuff!
lines.zh: : 而你还很擅长……那些事！

lines.en: : Sorry. I planned out a bunch of compliments for my original date, but she’s doing homework right now.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我为原本的约会对象准备了一堆夸奖，可她现在正在写作业。

lines.en: : I’ll get back to you with some nice stuff later once I can think of some.
lines.zh: : 等我想出好听的话，回头再补给你。

lines.en: scene rindate24
: But for now, let’s play some games and forget about our feelings!
lines.zh: : 不过现在嘛，我们来玩游戏，把感情什么的都忘掉！

lines.en: scene black
Rin leads me to the back of the arcade rather confidently despite never having been here before.
lines.zh: Rin 虽然从没来过这儿，却相当自信地把我领到了游戏厅后面。

lines.en: I guess she really did her research online first.
lines.zh: 看来她确实事先在网上做过功课。

lines.en: The only issue is that now I have to try to not look like a complete imbecile playing whichever game Rin decides she wants to play first.
lines.zh: 唯一的问题是，现在无论 Rin 先挑哪台机器玩，我都得尽量别让自己看起来像个彻头彻尾的傻子。

lines.en: As long as it’s not one of those...dancing machines I’ve seen other [teenager]s play, though, I should be fine.
lines.zh: 只要不是那种……我见过别的 [teenager] 玩的跳舞机就行，那样我应该还扛得住。

lines.en: scene rindate25
Nevermind. There is apparently more than one type of machine that can make me feel like a child.
lines.zh: 当我没说。显然能让我觉得自己像个小孩的机器不止一种。

lines.en: I do not like this.
lines.zh: 我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : You look like a moron right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在看起来跟个白痴一样。

lines.en: : I want to insult you as well but you look pretty fucking cool.
lines.zh: : 我也想回敬你一句，可你他妈看起来还挺帅的。

lines.en: : It’s the hoodie, not me.
lines.zh: : 是帽衫的功劳，不是我。

lines.en: : It definitely helps.
lines.zh: : 确实加分不少。

lines.en: scene rindate26
: So, it’s probably safe to assume you’ve never played anything like this before, right?
lines.zh: : 那么，基本可以断定你以前从没玩过这类东西，对吧？

lines.en: : Very safe. I have absolutely no idea what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 非常可以。我完全不知道自己在干什么。

lines.en: : Just make sure you have your feet on the little foot-holder thingies and put both hands on the grips up here.
lines.zh: : 只要把脚踩在那两个小脚踏板上，双手握住上面这两个把手就行。

lines.en: : You’ll notice a button on one of them. Press that to accelerate and move the bars around to steer.
lines.zh: : 你会注意到其中一个上面有个按钮。按它加速，转动车把来转向。

lines.en: : Each race has three laps and it’ll be you, me, and a bunch of AI opponents.
lines.zh: : 每场比赛三圈，对手是你、我，还有一堆 AI。

lines.en: : Don’t underestimate them, though. This game might be a little retro, but the AI will fuck your day up.
lines.zh: : 不过别小看它们。这游戏可能有点复古，但 AI 会把你打得找不着北。

lines.en: : I am fully prepared for my day to be fucked up. Congratulations on defeating me in advance.
lines.zh: : 我已经做好被收拾得找不着北的准备了。提前恭喜你击败我。

lines.en: : Hey, man. There’s no fun if you give up beforehand. You’ve gotta at least try.
lines.zh: : 嘿，兄弟。事先认输就没意思了。你至少得试试啊。

lines.en: : Just think of how easy it would be to tease me if you defeated me at a game I literally taught you how to play.
lines.zh: : 想想看，要是在一个我手把手教你怎么玩的游戏上你赢了我，逗我该有多容易。

lines.en: : One can only hope.
lines.zh: : 只能指望这个了。

lines.en: scene rindate27
: Ready to do this, then?
lines.zh: : 那准备好了吗？

lines.en: : As ready as I’ll ever be...
lines.zh: : 准备好得不能再准备好了……

lines.en: : Good! Then-
lines.zh: : 好！那么——

lines.en: scene rindate28
: Prepare to get railed~
lines.zh: : 准备挨肏吧～

lines.en: : I understand that the game’s tagline is “Rail on” but don’t you think what you just said is a little...racy?
lines.zh: : 我知道这游戏的标语是「Rail on」，但你不觉得你刚才那句话有点……暧昧吗？

lines.en: : I’m gonna rail you so hard.
lines.zh: : 我要把你肏得很惨。

lines.en: : Uh-huh.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : So hard you won’t even be able to walk afterward.
lines.zh: : 惨到你事后连路都走不了。

lines.en: : And then when I’m done, I’m gonna call Ami over and rail your [niece].
lines.zh: : 等我完事了，我还要把 Ami 叫来，肏你的 [niece]。

lines.en: : Rin, please.
lines.zh: : Rin，拜托。

lines.en: : I’m gonna rail {i}everybody{/i}. All day. All night.
lines.zh: : 我要肏{i}所有人{/i}。白天晚上都不停。

lines.en: : You’ll be begging me to rail you again once we leave today. Calling it now.
lines.zh: : 等我们今天走了，你会求着我再肏你一次的。先说好了。

lines.en: : If your plan is to distract me through phrases that can be easily misinterpreted, it’s really not necessary.
lines.zh: : 如果你的计划是用容易被误解的话来分散我的注意力，那真没必要。

lines.en: : You’re going to win no matter what.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样你都会赢。

lines.en: : What can I say? I’ve been railing ever since I was a little girl.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢？我从小就一直在肏人了。

lines.en: : I know my way around the block, man.
lines.zh: : 这条街我熟得很，兄弟。

lines.en: scene rindate29
: NOW, PREPARE TO DIE, LOSER!
lines.zh: : 现在，受死吧，输家！

lines.en: scene rindate30
Rin’s shout was a bit pre-emptive as we still needed to select a track and I guess...different types of motorcycles or something?
lines.zh: Rin 喊得有点早了，因为我们还没选赛道，而且我看还得选……不同类型的摩托车之类的？

lines.en: I don’t know. I chose the first one I saw and, as expected, was demolished so quickly that I couldn’t even blame the bike.
lines.zh: 我不知道。我挑了第一眼看到的那个，然后毫无悬念地被秒成渣，快得我连怪车都怪不上。

lines.en: The same pattern repeated for the next few hours.
lines.zh: 同样的剧情在接下来的几个小时里反复上演。

lines.en: Rin would take me to a machine, explain how the machine works, and then make me look like an absolute idiot in front of the...three other people that were there.
lines.zh: Rin 会把我带到一台机器前，讲解机器怎么玩，然后让我在……在场那另外三个人面前出尽洋相。

lines.en: I’m pretty sure they may have even started laughing at me after a while.
lines.zh: 我很确定他们到后来可能都开始笑我了。

lines.en: And while something like this would normally bother me, today it was fine.
lines.zh: 而这种事平时本来会让我在意，今天却无所谓。

lines.en: Because not only was the purpose of this trip to help cheer Rin up after the new object of her affection bailed on her-
lines.zh: 因为这次出门不仅是为了在她新看上的人放了鸽子之后哄她开心——

lines.en: But it was the first few hours in quite some time that I’ve felt like she was actually focused on me.
lines.zh: 也是这么长时间以来，头几个小时让我觉得她其实是真的把注意力放在我身上。

lines.en: Backup date or not, it was fun getting to see this side of her.
lines.zh: 备胎约会也好，不是也好，能看到她这一面挺开心的。

lines.en: Otoha really did miss out on something great this afternoon.
lines.zh: Otoha 今天下午是真的错过了一场好事。

lines.en: scene black
Eventually, we run out of machines to try out and head over to a pizzeria on the corner of the street.
lines.zh: 最后，我们把所有机器都玩遍了，走到街角的一家披萨店。

lines.en: We take our time sharing a pizza and wind up begrudgingly leaving one slice that we were unable to finish behind.
lines.zh: 我们不紧不慢地分吃了一个披萨，最后不情不愿地剩下一片没吃完。

lines.en: Instead of the night ending there, though, Rin urges me to come back to the dorm since she still has more time to kill and Futaba is with Nodoka tonight.
lines.zh: 不过这一晚并没有到此结束，Rin 催我回宿舍，因为她还有时间要打发，而 Futaba 今晚跟 Nodoka 在一起。

lines.en: Having nothing else to do, I obviously agree and allow the backup date to move into its second phase.
lines.zh: 反正也没别的事，我当然是答应了，让这场备胎约会进入第二阶段。

lines.en: $ rin_love += 1
$ cafe45 = True
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Rin 的好感度提升到了 [rin_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump rindorm45
